summary.en: Conditionals let a program choose between paths and loops let it repeat work, and between them they turn a fixed list of instructions into something whose behaviour depends on its data.
summary.et: Tingimuslaused lasevad programmil teede vahel valida ja tsüklid lasevad tööd korrata ning koos muudavad need kindla käskude loendi millekski, mille käitumine sõltub andmetest.
